name: [Photo] Intentional Camera Movement
nl: ICM rendering: the camera swept deliberately through a slow exposure, forms drawn into soft vertical or arcing streaks, colour surviving as banded washes, one faint edge left half-legible, photograph style image.

name: [Experimental] Pixel Sorting
nl: Pixel-sort rendering: rows of pixels reordered by brightness, forms smearing sideways into ribbon bands, hard thresholds where sorting stops and starts, untouched blocks left intact between them, abstract style image.
